ingredients.name: water at room temperature, used as needed

healthBenefits.title: Slow-Release Energy
healthBenefits.text: Durum wheat semolina has a lower glycemic index than regular flour, providing sustained energy release.

healthBenefits.title: Good Plant Protein Source
healthBenefits.text: Semolina provides a moderate amount of protein, supporting muscle repair and satiety.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Iron
healthBenefits.text: Durum wheat contains iron, which supports oxygen transport and helps prevent fatigue.

healthBenefits.title: Dietary Fibre Content
healthBenefits.text: The semolina flour retains fibre from the wheat germ, aiding digestion and gut health.

healthBenefits.title: Low Fat, Low Sodium
healthBenefits.text: This simple dough recipe is naturally low in fat and sodium, supporting heart health.

healthBenefits.title: B Vitamins for Metabolism
healthBenefits.text: Semolina contains B vitamins like niacin and thiamin, important for energy metabolism and nervous system function.

_ingredientsText:
400 gr of durum wheat semolina flour
200 gr water at room temperature, used as needed
